newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets see subdued start to year.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets see subdued start to year.

text.p: European cotton-buying activity was subdued on Thursday with noteworthy price movements focussed on January-February shipments of U.S. and Australian origins which were all up by 0.75 cents a lb, industry sources said.
Turkish Adanas were also quoted 1.00 cents higher, but there were few firm trades to report, they said.
Central Asian types began the New Year unchanged as fears over future quality had market players adopting a wait-and-see approach to trade.
